taskQueue.name: Create Task Queue Component
taskQueue.description: Create src/components/TaskQueue.tsx to display task queue from session.state.taskQueue. Show task priority, name, and completion status. Highlight current task (not completed). Handle empty/null queue. Use Badge for task status
taskQueue.validationRationale: Batch component creation, validate after all components complete

taskQueue.name: Create Terminal Output Component
taskQueue.description: Create src/components/TerminalOutput.tsx to display CLI stdout logs. Use Zustand store logs state. Implement auto-scroll to bottom using useRef and useEffect. Style as terminal with black background, green text, monospace font. Fixed height 256px with overflow-y-auto
taskQueue.validationRationale: Batch component creation, validate after all components complete

taskQueue.name: Build Main Application Integration
taskQueue.description: Create src/App.tsx integrating all components. Load projects on mount using listProjects(). Watch session.json when project selected using watchSession(). Implement handleRunCode to execute CLI via executeCodeTask(). Layout: Header at top, ProjectList sidebar (w-64), SessionView and TaskQueue in main area, TerminalOutput at bottom. Use Zustand store for state management
taskQueue.validationRationale: Main integration complete - full validation of all components working together

taskQueue.name: Create Project Documentation
taskQueue.description: Create README.md with project overview, architecture explanation (file-based monitoring, no backend/API), setup instructions (pnpm install, pnpm dev), usage guide (select project, run code, view session), and technology stack. Document the 6 core features: project list, project selection, CLI execution, session watching, task queue display, terminal output
taskQueue.validationRationale: Documentation only, no code validation needed

taskQueue.name: Final Integration & Verification
taskQueue.description: Verify all MVP requirements are fully implemented: 1) Project list displays workspace/ directories, 2) Project selection works, 3) Run Code button executes ANT CLI via child_process, 4) session.json real-time watching with chokidar, 5) Task queue displays from session.state.taskQueue with current task highlighted, 6) Terminal output shows CLI stdout with auto-scroll. Verify NO backend/API/WebSocket code exists (forbidden directories check). Ensure fixed 1920x1080 layout works. Test complete workflow: select project → run code → watch session updates → view tasks → see terminal output
taskQueue.validationRationale: Final comprehensive validation of entire MVP application and architecture constraints
